process.orientation: Inspect actual FRONT/REVERSE/ABOVE/UNDERSIDE views with fixed production transforms. An explicit upright pose and front can be approved from those views when mouth, base and handles are clear; only axis-ambiguous works require additional local orientation variants. No axis or yaw is approved from metadata alone.
process.multi_view: Once an explicit pose is proposed and rendered, inspect FRONT/REVERSE/ABOVE/UNDERSIDE in the production-transformed frame and original/native or material-normalized source reference. Wrong provisional pose does not establish anatomical top/bottom.
process.appearance: Unsupported native source material extensions require a labeled reference conversion or an explicit hold; a white unsupported source row never establishes fidelity.
process.approval: All41 listed pass decisions follow actual bound eight-view contact inspection, with exact source/preview SHA and byte bindings; root/peer final thumbnails are separately bound. No physical calibration or exact AR is authorized.
process.local_renderer: System Google Chrome, ALLOW_LOCAL_SCOPE_RENDER=1, CHROME_EXTRA_ARGS=--no-sandbox; retained originals are read through existing private one-to-source-transfer alias. Full-bound R2 previews and legacy material references are task-temporary and removed by renderer; no additional original copies.
